response.title: The story of Armenian Quarter
response.summary: The Armenian Quarter is a compact Old City quarter organised around the Armenian Patriarchate and Cathedral of St James, with religious, residential, educational and cultural institutions.
response.narrative:
The Armenian Quarter is a compact Old City quarter organised around the Armenian Patriarchate and Cathedral of St James, with religious, residential, educational and cultural institutions.

Things to look for:
- Cathedral of St James.
- Armenian Museum.
- Armenian Patriarchate.

A few facts:
- Armenian ceramics are a modern Jerusalem craft tradition rooted in Armenian artistic practice.
uncertainty_notes: Gaps the AI must not fill: private monastic areas, individual artisan histories and exact community population.
Periods describing sieges, destruction or war were left out of the child-friendly version; they are present in the reviewed source.
